messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's RFC sync: we need one clear ownership table for the cross-mode surfaces. current wording is ambiguous around secrets, rollouts, and offline behavior.
aj: Agreed. Let's enumerate the surfaces and pick owners rather than prose. Helps on-call and integrations.
nina: Biggest open for me: how much logic stays in control-plane vs runtime for Dedicated. customers expect some isolation but also low-latency decisions.
rob: Practical constraint: Dedicated runtimes often live in the same VPC as the control-plane for some customers. For true Private (air-gapped) we cannot assume any control-plane runtime. So we need an explicit "local policy" model.
maria: Proposed surface list: AUTHZ (token validation), KMS (unwrap/delegation), ROLLOUTS (canary/pct), ROUTING (model/variant decision), TELEMETRY (span and cost reporting), CACHING (kv/prefix invalidation). For each we should state owner: control-plane | runtime | hybrid, and failure-mode (fail-open|fail-closed|degrade).
aj: Quick suggestions: AuthZ = control-plane primary, runtime caches short-lived tokens and can validate locally when offline (degrade). KMS = runtime-owned in Private (fail-closed), control-delegated in Hosted (fail-open+audit).
nina: For Dedicated: offer a plugin model where customer supplies KMS endpoint; default is control-delegated. Need a capability flag so runtime advertises "KMS_PROXY".
rob: We also need a tiny capability handshake protocol. Keep it minimal so older runtimes can still interoperate. Sketch:
```
// RPC from control -> runtime
Handshake() -> {version, capabilities: [KMS_PROXY, LOCAL_POLICY, STREAMS, QUANTIZED] }
CheckRoute(reqMeta) -> {decision: routeKey, fallbackHints}
ApplyPolicyBlob(blob, signature) -> {ok|err}
ReportUsage(reqId, tokens, latency) -> ok

// from runtime -> control
Notify(tenant, eventType, details)
```
This keeps adapters thin.
maria: +1. Add a capability bit for "OFFLINE_SIGN_VERIFICATION" so Private runtimes without online KMS can verify signed blobs.
aj: On rollouts: control-plane should publish signed rollout blobs with TTL. runtime applies locally when offline and reports decision via ReportUsage so metrics still align. Nina, can you draft the blob shape?
nina: will do. initial shape: issuer, scope (zid, route), decisions [{model, pct}], issued_at, exp, sig. JSON compact, signed with control key.
rob: Observability: agree we need a naming convention. My proposal: all request-level spans include request_id. control-plane spans prefixed cp:, runtimes use rt:. Token/billing attribution happens in control-plane, runtime sends token counts and model-id.
maria: Important: compatibility policy: if runtime advertises missing capability, control-plane treats it as 'limited' and will not rely on that feature for routing. No hard failures. Migration plan: advertise-only window (30d) -> soft-route enforcement (60d) -> strict (90d).
aj: Security nuance: when KMS unreachable in Hosted, control-plane can optionally fall back to cached unwrap results for a short TTL (audited). but any credential misuse risk must be documented.
nina: Also add an explicit fallback ordering doc: same-runtime-variant -> regional-runtime -> hosted-fallback (if allowed by tenant). Each step logs and increments SLA impact.
rob: Actionables: (1) maria: author the ownership table and include fallback ordering examples. (2) aj: produce the minimal RPC protobuf and compatibility notes. (3) nina: rollout blob spec + sig verification flow. (4) rob: tracing naming doc + example query to join cp/rt traces.
infra-bot: backlog: create infra tasks for telemetry schema and capability flags. tracker: #INF-4521, #INF-4522.
deploy-bot: note: changing Handshake() response to include OFFLINE_SIGN_VERIFICATION requires small API version bump. recommend deploy slot 04/01 10:00-11:00 UTC.
maria: timeline: let's aim for PRs this week. please include concrete examples for KMS unavailable and an air-gapped runtime applying signed rollouts. That will speed reviews.
aj: I'll own the PR for the RPC interface. posting by EOD.
nina: I'll drop a draft blob spec in the PR and link verification pseudo-code.
rob: I'll put the trace samples and a Kibana query snippet in a follow-up thread.
maria: thanks everyone 44d. closing thread; will link RFC update once PRs are up.
